newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate lower, baht firmer late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate lower, baht firmer late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate fell sharply in late trading on Tuesday on sustained return of funds withdrawan earlier during the year-end holiday and after banks met cash reserve obligations by the Tuesday deadline, dealers said.
They said the overnight rate eased to 9.25-9.50 percent shortly before closing from 10.25-10.50 in the morning.
"I expect the rate to go up a little tomorrow since that is what normally happens on the first day of a new fortnight reserve cycle," said a dealer at Bangkok Bank.
"I expect the rate to hover at 9-10 percent for most of the rest of the week," she said.
The baht, rallying strongly against a sharply easier dollar, firmed to 25.590-25.610 to the dollar near the finish from 25.602-25.606 in the morning.
The bid/offer range of one month baht/dollar swap premium was quoted at 9.00/9.50 satang per dollar against 9.60/10.60 earlier.
